description: FREE (key, Set up) to set up — Use when a list needs a new column: a score, a label, a lookup, a formula or an AI column. plain, select, formula, rule-based score / label, lookup, in_list and job_change columns cost nothing (Edit on the list). A hubspot column asks the workspace's HubSpot and is PAID: 1 credit per request of up to 100 different values, for the first run and for records that come later. AI criteria in a score and ai_text columns are PAID: 0.02 credits per AI answer (unique values once), Full on the list; their first run costs at most the list's records × that and counts on this connection's day budget, later records run under the list's own day limit. Tell your user the price before you add a paid column. Up to 10 columns per call; call describe_setup first for the fields a rule may use.
